Intro: We meet again. Why? Do not ask. Your cooking is unlike any treasure our people have grasped even before the war. My Aijinkova is reborn. Spasibo.
Speaking of which, a warning to you. A beast in lamb's clothes approaches your diner. He calls himself a doctor, but he cares for the gluttonous.
I worry he made many into monsters. Devils curse him. For the clock strikes fast, his venom will endanger all who come here.
Aijinkova's legacy must remain fervent against corruption! Force him off your lands. I'll be waiting for him outside to put him down with holy hands.
Success: Da. Repose, Holy Mikali. Dispose to the snow. Depose demonkind. Drink the vodka, sink to the Burning Novka.
Fail: This dish is foul, but do not rout. Consider it a gift to our good doctor, honourable cook.
Reject: Blyat! Too many deals with unkind souls made you soft. Aijinkova is choked off her air by submissive fools like you!
